new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Apply

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com .

LOCATION:
APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone)
.

THE ROLE:

As a Senior Project Manager at APPLY, you'll play a critical role in delivering exceptional digital solutions and fostering strong client relationships. Reporting into the Project Management team, you will lead complex projects spanning digital strategy, products, platforms, and marketing initiatives — driving excellence in project delivery while championing Agile methodologies and ensuring client satisfaction through effective communication and strategic problem-solving.

You bring a background from the digital agency or consultancy side, with proven experience delivering integrated digital experiences alongside a collaborative, team-oriented mindset. As a champion of project management best practices, you'll bring fluency in Agile while adapting, growing, and optimizing teams to apply the best methodologies for the right problems — driving flawless execution and delivery for your clients. You have your pulse on the day-to-day details but care about the big picture, and can move effortlessly between the two to drive transformation for your clients' businesses.

You are also, unapologetically, an AI-forward delivery leader. APPLY delivers through an agentic model in which human practitioners work alongside AI agents across the project lifecycle, and the Senior Project Manager is accountable for making that model work: setting the guardrails, owning the review gates, and keeping human judgment at the centre of everything that leaves our door. You are hungry for all things AI, you enjoy pulling apart your own processes to make them better, and you are energised rather than unsettled by how quickly this landscape moves.

Responsibilities

Project & Program Management

Lead complex digital projects and programs from initiation to completion, managing scope, roadmaps, timelines, resourcing, and budgets across fixed-price and T&M agreements.
Translate client business outcomes into actionable project plans, roadmaps, and execution strategies.
Own core delivery artifacts end-to-end (SOWs, plans, resource trackers, status reports, risk/issue logs, and closure decks).
Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks, issues, dependencies and decisions escalating appropriately to senior stakeholders.
Adapt Agile, hybrid-Agile, or waterfall methodologies to match project needs and drive process efficiency.
Continuously streamline delivery workflows and status reporting using AI tools and smart automation.
Build and share reusable assets—prompts, templates, and best practices—to strengthen the Project Management discipline.

Agentic & AI-Enabled Delivery

Own delivery accountability and guardrails on agentic engagements, ensuring human review and approval for all AI-assisted outputs.
Scope and structure work effectively between AI agents and team members, maintaining clear review gates and risk logs.
Manage agentic failure modes (hallucinations, model drift, data dependencies, prompt quality) and maintain agent access/permission boundaries.
Align client expectations to an agentic operating model, emphasizing outcome-based metrics, transparent AI usage, and fast review cycles.
Report on outcome as well as activity — time to value, delivery velocity against a human-only baseline, and measurable value validation — not simply story counts and burn.

Client & Stakeholder Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, providing clear, concise, and proactive updates on progress, milestones, and scope changes.
Facilitate key workshops and client meetings (strategy sessions, UX reviews, demos) with clear agendas and actionable outcomes.
Navigate complex stakeholder discussions diplomatically, managing expectations and delivering difficult news early and constructively.
Partner with Client Services and account leadership to identify growth opportunities and ensure business value alignment.
Accurately discern stakeholder requirements and integrate them into planning and execution; actively manage client expectations, and delegate where appropriate rather than becoming a single point of dependency.
Maintain a healthy partnership with Client Services and support account growth activities, bringing commercial awareness to delivery conversations.

Team Leadership

Lead cross-functional teams (Strategy, Design, Engineering, QA, Data) using servant leadership to foster collaboration and high performance.
Guide, mentor, and coach Project Managers and Coordinators, proactively supporting their professional development.
Resolve team friction with empathy and candor, diffusing tension and focusing on solution-oriented outcomes.
Exemplify project management at APPLY, earning trust from both the project team and the leadership team.

Requirements

Project Management Excellence

8+ years leading end-to-end digital solution delivery in consulting or agency environments for enterprise clients.
Proven ability to partner effectively with senior client leadership (Director, VP, C-suite).
Expertise in Agile and waterfall delivery frameworks, with the flexibility to select the right approach for each engagement.
Experience with modern digital ecosystems (Composable/Headless CMS, E-commerce, Loyalty, Personalization, Analytics).
Strong proficiency in industry-standard project management and collaboration tools including JIRA, Confluence, Notion, Instagantt, Smartsheet, and Google Suite.
Deep knowledge of the full software development lifecycle, CI/CD, and related delivery workflows across product, design, development, and QA.
Experience leading headless implementations across platforms such as e-commerce (CommerceTools, BigCommerce), CMS (Contentful, Contentstack), Loyalty (Talon.one, EagleEye), Identity (Stytch, Okta, Auth0), and Personalization (Ninetailed, Segment).
Knowledge of technical concepts including AI, machine learning, data analytics, cloud computing, and platform integrations.
Demonstrable critical thinking, creative problem-solving, and willingness to tackle complex challenges.
A can-do attitude, passion for digital products, and resilience to work in a flexible, fast-paced environment.

Communication & Soft Skills

Communication Excellence: You possess impeccable written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively bridge the gap between executive summaries and technical detail, provide proactive updates, and communicate complex or difficult news with transparency and clarity.
Interpersonal Intelligence: You demonstrate high emotional intelligence, reading rooms effectively and navigating conflict with empathy. You practice compassionate candor, resolving tensions by focusing on solutions, and can influence stakeholders without formal authority.
Leadership & Mindset: You are customer-centric, taking full accountability for project outcomes rather than just tasks. You lead with a coaching instinct, fostering growth in those around you, and maintain the resilience and adaptability required to thrive in a fast-changing, AI-driven environment.

AI & Agentic Delivery

As APPLY operates on an agentic model, hands-on AI fluency is essential. You will use these tools daily and comfortably engage in technical discussions around agentic workflows.

Required:

Hands-on experience using LLMs (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and AI workflows to accelerate planning, documentation, and reporting, with a drive to continuously adapt as tools evolve.
Proven critical evaluation skills to review and refine AI outputs for accuracy, quality, and strategic alignment before client delivery.
A genuine hunger for all things AI and a commitment to keep growing with a field that changes month to month. You experiment, you share what you learn, and you expect the way you work in twelve months to look different from today.

Strong bonus

Direct experience leading agentic delivery—structuring ceremonies where AI drafts and humans decide, introducing AI workflows to clients, and managing the associated change.
Familiarity with BMAD methodology, Markdown, CLI-based AI tools (e.g., Claude Code), and MCP connectors.
Track record of building reusable AI skills, agents, or automations adopted by other team members.
Relevant AI certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Generative AI Leader, Gemini Enterprise Certified Partner Specialist, Anthropic Academy).

Nice to Have

Experience working in Commerce and/or Loyalty programs.
Technical background in Computer Science.
PMP, Agile, or Scrum Master certification.
Experience delivering AI or agentic products for clients, not only using AI to deliver traditional products.

What Success Looks Like

You have delivered at least two medium-to-large projects of each engagement type — Upstream, Midstream, and Downstream — from kickoff through closure.
Your clients would describe the experience as transparent, well-run, and better than what they have had elsewhere.
Your engagements demonstrate measurable value against an agreed baseline, not just completed activity.
Something you built, improved, or documented is being used by PjMs beyond your own project.

LIFE AT APPLY

People are at the core of everything we do at APPLY. We provide you with modern tools, systems and approaches, value your time, safety, and health, and strive to build a work community where you can thrive and grow. Here are a few benefits we offer to support you:

Agentic Delivery:
Our people work in a modern way to deliver client outcomes. Broaden your skills on a range of engagements with international brands that have a global impact.

An inclusive and safe environment:
We’re truly committed to building a culture where you are celebrated and everyone feels welcome and safe.

AI & Strategic Upskilling:
Accelerate your professional growth with generous training budgets and mentorship, with a specific focus on Agentic AI expertise and the critical human skills required for the future of work.

Generous vacation policy:
Work-life balance is key to our team’s success, so we offer flexible personal time off (PTO); allowing ample time away from work to promote overall well-being.

Customizable benefits:
Tailor your extended health and dental plan to your needs, priorities, and preferences.

Flexible work arrangements:
We work in a variety of ways, from remote, to in-office, to a blend of both.

APPLY is a safe, respectful, and inclusive community where differences are celebrated. We are committed to equal opportunity and fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. Learn more in our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) section. For recruitment accommodations, please email [email protected] .

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Project Manager who enjoys bringing people, ideas, and plans together to get meaningful work done.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for guiding projects from the early planning stage through completion. You’ll work closely with different teams, keep everyone aligned, manage timelines and priorities, and make sure the details don’t get lost along the way.

More than anything, we’re looking for someone who is organized, practical, and comfortable working with people. You don’t need to have every answer on day one, but you should know how to ask the right questions, communicate clearly, and keep things moving when challenges come up.

What You’ll Do

Lead projects from planning through delivery, keeping scope, timelines, and priorities on track.
Work closely with internal teams, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders to keep everyone aligned.
Build project plans, establish milestones, and make sure responsibilities are clear.
Monitor progress, identify risks early, and work with the right people to resolve issues.
Keep stakeholders informed through clear, timely, and straightforward communication.
Coordinate meetings, follow-ups, action items, and important project documentation.
Help teams stay focused when priorities change or unexpected challenges come up.
Track project budgets, resources, and timelines where required.
Look for better ways to improve how projects are planned, managed, and delivered.
Step in when something is unclear and help turn it into a practical next step.

What We’re Looking For

Experience managing projects from start to finish.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Clear, confident communication and the ability to work well with different personalities and teams.
A practical approach to solving problems rather than simply pointing them out.
The ability to manage several priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Comfort working with changing priorities and deadlines.
Strong attention to detail without getting stuck in the details.
Experience with project management tools and collaboration platforms.
A team-first mindset and a genuine interest in helping others succeed.

What Will Make You Successful

You’re someone people can rely on. When you say you’ll follow up, you do. When a project starts to drift, you notice it and take action. When there’s a difficult conversation to have, you don’t avoid it.

You understand that project management is not just about schedules, spreadsheets, and status updates. It’s about people. It’s about creating clarity, building trust, removing roadblocks, and helping a team do its best work.

Why Join Us

We want people to feel that their work matters and that their contribution is noticed. You’ll have the opportunity to work with talented people, take ownership of meaningful projects, and have a real say in how we improve the way we work.

If you’re the kind of Project Manager who likes turning plans into progress and enjoys seeing a team succeed together, we’d love to hear from you.

The role ensures subcontractor activities align with Vigor Marine Fabrication operations and overall production flow.

Serving as the primary interface between shipyard program teams and subcontractors performing specialized work (structural, piping, electrical, propulsion, machinery, and systems integration), this position is accountable for subcontractor performance across cost, schedule, quality, and delivery.

This role combines Subcontractor Program Management and Subcontractor Administration, requiring candidates with shipyard experience in both subcontract oversight and contract administration (material and service procurement tracking).

Essential Functions And Major Responsibilities

Subcontractor Program Leadership

Lead subcontractor execution from award through vessel delivery. Serve as the main liaison between subcontractors and shipyard teams, ensuring clarity of scope, alignment with ship specifications, and performance against cost, schedule, and quality goals.

Ship Construction Integration

Integrate subcontractor work into the ship construction plan, coordinating fabrication, module construction, outfitting, and shipboard installation. Ensure smooth multi‑trade sequencing with structural, pipe, electrical, mechanical, and systems integration teams.

Planning and Scheduling Coordination

Align subcontractor activities with the Integrated Master Schedule and key production milestones (block erection, launch, trials, delivery, sustainment). Track schedule performance and support mitigation plans when risks arise.

Subcontract Administration

Draft, issue, and manage subcontracts and purchase orders; ensure compliance with FAR/DFARS and flow‑down requirements; handle modifications, invoices, funding, audit‑ready documentation, and supplier compliance.

Engineering and Technical Coordination

Provide subcontractors with current drawings and specifications, coordinate engineering changes, and maintain configuration control and adherence to technical baselines.

Material and Supply Chain Coordination

Ensure subcontractors receive required materials and equipment, monitor material availability, and identify risks that could impact construction milestones.

Cost and Contract Performance

Monitor subcontract cost performance, manage scope adjustments and modifications, review progress reports, validate milestones, and support financial oversight.

Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance

Ensure subcontractor work meets shipyard quality standards, regulatory requirements, and contract specifications. Coordinate inspections, testing, acceptance, and compliance with oversight authorities.

Required

Either a bachelor’s degree in engineering, marine engineering, naval architecture, program management, or related field, or equivalent professional experience in Shipbuilding Program Management and an associate’s degree.
Strong knowledge of shipyard new‑construction processes (fabrication, block assembly, outfitting, system installation).
Understanding of ship construction sequencing and multi‑trade production flow. Experience managing subcontractors performing specialized shipbuilding work.
Knowledge of FAR/DFARS and subcontract flow‑down requirements.

About The Role

We're looking for a hands-on Security Manager to own our organization's day-to-day security posture — across our people, endpoints, software, and vendors. This role sits at the intersection of governance, technical security operations, and emerging AI risk. You'll be the person who knows where our exposure is, who's using what, and whether our controls actually hold up under testing.

We need someone comfortable both setting standards and getting into the weeds — reviewing a vendor's SOC 2 report one hour, scoping a vulnerability scan the next, and evaluating whether a new AI tool an employee wants to use is safe to approve.

What You'll Do

Employee & Endpoint Security

Monitor employee security practices, device compliance, and adherence to internal security policies
Maintain visibility into laptops, mobile devices, and endpoints — encryption status, EDR/antivirus coverage, and configuration drift
Manage identity and access controls (least privilege, MFA, offboarding, privileged access reviews)
Run security awareness training and phishing simulations
Software & Shadow IT Oversight
Maintain an inventory of software and SaaS tools in use across the organization, including unsanctioned ("shadow IT") applications
Evaluate and approve new software and AI tools before adoption, assessing data handling, permissions, and vendor risk
Track license and application sprawl as a security (not just cost) issue

AI Security

Stay current on AI-specific risks: prompt injection, data leakage through AI tools, model/vendor data retention policies, unsanctioned use of generative AI on sensitive data, and supply-chain risk in AI-powered products
Develop and enforce acceptable-use policies for AI tools and copilots
Assess AI vendors and features embedded in existing software (e.g., new AI features rolled into SaaS products) for security implications

Third-Party & Vendor Risk

Conduct vendor security assessments and due diligence before and during engagements
Review vendor security documentation (SOC 2, ISO 27001 certifications, penetration test summaries, security questionnaires)
Maintain a third-party risk register and reassess periodically based on criticality and data access

Technical Security Operations

Coordinate or perform vulnerability scanning across infrastructure, endpoints, and applications
Manage or oversee penetration testing engagements (internal team or external vendors), track findings through remediation
Perform cyber risk assessments across systems, business units, and processes
Support incident response: detection, triage, containment, and post-incident review

Governance, Risk & Compliance

Maintain and mature the security program in alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF/800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2
Ensure practices support compliance with data privacy regulations including GDPR and CCPA/CPRA
Own or contribute to security policies, standards, and audit readiness
Report on security posture, risk, and metrics to leadership

Requirements

4+ years in information security, with at least 1–2 years in a security management, GRC, or senior analyst role
Working knowledge of NIST, ISO 27001, GDPR, and CCPA/CPRA requirements
Although we outsource these functions, familiarity with vulnerability scanning tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, Tenable); with penetration testing methodology (internal team or managing external testers); and with Security Operations functions (SOC) and how to work with our MSSP to mitigate and remediate events
Experience with endpoint management/MDM tools and understanding of laptop/device security controls
Familiarity with SaaS/vendor risk assessment processes
Emerging understanding of AI security risks and governance — you don't need to be an ML engineer, but you should be able to speak intelligently about the risks generative AI and AI-embedded tools introduce
Strong communication skills — able to translate technical risk into business terms for non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable balancing policy/governance work with hands-on technical review

Nice to Have

Relevant certifications: CISSP[RM1.1], CISM, Security+, GSEC, CEH, or similar
Experience building or maturing a security program from an early stage
Prior experience in a regulated industry (finance, healthcare, or similar)

Why Join Us

Avant’s culture, the envy of the technology channel, is loaded with A players, self-starters and outgoing rockstars. We focus on empowering our staff to run and make decisions and as a company, we have 300+ people all moving in the same direction.

Our work-life balance is normal, benefits are competitive, and it is generally exciting to work for Avant.

401K Match

Generous Parental Leave

Through three unique rotations, you will build technical expertise in cybersecurity and risk while developing the leadership skills needed to protect Vanguard and its clients.

Protect What Matters Most

At Vanguard, we’re committed to doing what’s right for our clients - and that starts with protecting their data, assets, and trust. As part of the Technology Leadership Program in the Risk & Security Analyst track, you’ll help identify, assess, and mitigate risks that impact Vanguard’s systems, operations, and clients. 该职位来源于猎聘 职位概述：负责收集、整理和分析行业及市场信息，支持公司业务发展、市场拓展及销售团队决策。通过对行业数据、项目机会和竞争对手的分析，为公司提供及时有效的市场情报。 主要职责： 行业信息收集  收集全球能源行业信息，重点关注海上风电、油气工程及海洋工程装备市场  跟踪行业政策、市场趋势及重大项目动态  定期整理行业新闻和市场简报 市场数据分析  收集市场数据并进行整理分析  建立和维护市场数据库  协助编制市场分析报告 竞争对手跟踪  收集主要竞争对手的项目案例、产品能力及市场布局  协助制作竞争对手分析报告  更新竞争对手数据库 项目机会信息收集  跟踪全球重点能源项目  整理潜在客户、业主及项目机会信息  协助业务团队进行市场机会分析 市场活动支持  收集行业活动信息并整理总结报告 职位要求：  本科及以上学历  市场营销、经济、国际贸易、工程管理等相关专业  熟悉海上风电或海洋工程产业链，有能源、工程或制造行业经验者优先  熟悉行业数据库或市场研究工具，较强的信息收集和数据整理能力  有国际市场研究经验  能够独立工作，并同时管理多个项目  注重细节，具备较强的分析和解决问题的能力  具备较强的审美能力  工作细致、有责任心、具备良好的协作精神  具备良好的中英文写作能力与沟通表达能力。其他语种为加分项  熟练使用 Excel、PowerPoint，有制作项目汇报/公司介绍/销售支持材料经验

new_jobs.description:
Job Description:
Credit Risk Strategy Analyst

Company:
Surfin Meta Digital Technology Pte Ltd

Company Description

Surfin is a global financial technology platform that focuses on providing a holistic suite of digital financial services for the unbanked and underbanked in emerging markets.

About the job

o Develop and optimize credit risk, fraud prevention, and operational risk strategies across multiple South and Southeast Asian markets
o Analyze portfolio performance using Vintage Analysis, Roll Rate Analysis, FPD, and other risk monitoring methodologies
o Explore internal and external data sources to identify data-driven risk optimization opportunities
o Build risk monitoring dashboards and provide actionable insights to business stakeholders
o Partner with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and regional teams to implement risk strategies
o Support regulatory compliance and collaborate with headquarters and local market teams

Looking for

We ae looking for a Risk Strategy Analyst to join our Risk Management team in Singapore.
If you're passionate about credit risk, fraud strategy, data analytics, and cross-regional collaboration, and want to build risk strategies across South and Southeast Asia, we'd love to hear from you.
o 2-5 years of experience in consumer finance, banking, fintech, or related industries
o Hands-on experience in Credit Risk Strategy or Fraud Strategy
o Strong SQL and Python skills
o Familiarity with the full credit lifecycle (pre-loan, mid-loan, post-loan)
o Knowledge of Vintage Analysis, Roll Rate Analysis, FICO Scorecards, and PD/LGD/EAD
o Singapore / PR preferred

Good to have:

o South and Southeast Asia multi-market experience
o Cross-regional risk coordination
o Experience in regulatory audit as well as scorecard modeling
o Bilingualism in English and Mandarin
o CFA / FRM

Why Join Us

At Surfin, you will:
o Enjoy regional exposure across Southeast Asia
o Structured career development and growth opportunities that will challenge your ability to think out of the box
o Join a collaborative and multi-discipline team culture where your ideas and contribution matter
o Collaborative, international working environment

If you are interested in this position, send your resume to zhuyibing@surfin.sg  specifying " Risk Strategy Analyst Application – Your Name " in the subject line.

new_jobs.description:
Role
: Research Analyst (Remote)
Location
: Remote (Work from Anywhere)
Job
Type
: Full-Time
Payout
: Competitive, based on experience

Role Overview:

We are hiring for one of our clients, seeking a Research Analyst - Advanced Math to work on a full-time basis. In this role, you will work on projects to help fine-tune large language models using strong analytical and English comprehension skills. You will read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, and validate claims made in content through online research.

Key Responsibilities:

• Answer a variety of analytical questions and create scenarios that train large language models to improve.
• Analyze distributions of sales by month across locations to determine which location has grown the most and justify reasoning.
• Solve logical puzzles by applying mathematical reasoning to train models on correct problem-solving approaches.
• Break down complex content into smaller logical blocks to facilitate fine-tuning of AI models.
• Validate claims made in content through online research to ensure accuracy in model training.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

• Strong analytical skills with a focus on mathematical reasoning and problem-solving.
• Proficiency in English, including reading, writing, and comprehension, to break down and summarize content.
• Ability to conduct online research to validate claims and gather relevant information.
• Capacity to work with large language models to improve their accuracy and reasoning capabilities.
• High school mathematics knowledge with the ability to apply it to real-world analytical questions.

More About the Opportunity:

This role offers a unique opportunity to work with a global leader in the Software Development | Technology, Information and Internet | Information Services | Data Infrastructure and Analytics industry, contributing to the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. You will gain expertise in leveraging AI to enhance analytical capabilities and future-proof your career.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

We hire based on skills and expertise. All qualified candidates are welcome regardless of background, experience, or prior employment history. Applications are reviewed solely on demonstrated technical ability and qualifications.

new_jobs.title: Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
Overview

At UES, we’re a team of more than 4,000 engineers, scientists, geologists, inspectors, technicians, and drillers united by a shared purpose—to make a meaningful impact in the communities we serve. As a national leader in geotechnical engineering, environmental consulting, and materials testing and inspection, we collaborate on transformative projects across transportation, energy, water, healthcare, and more. Learn more about the benefits of joining Team UES and our core values at careers.teamues.com.

Position Overview

The Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) Project Manager
will lead and grow SUE capabilities across the Midwest East Area. This is a hands-on technical and operational leadership role responsible for delivering subsurface utility investigations, developing and mentoring field staff, managing projects and client relationships, and expanding UES's presence in these service lines.

The ideal candidate is an experienced SUE professional who enjoys being both a technical practitioner and a business builder. This individual will initially spend substantial time in the field working alongside the team, providing technical leadership and training, while progressively building the people, processes, client relationships, and project pipeline necessary to support a growing regional practice. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between field execution, technical interpretation, project management, staff development, client consultation, and business development. The successful candidate will serve as a regional technical resource and help position UES for continued growth in utility locating, concrete scanning, SUE, and related subsurface investigation services.

Responsibilities

Lead and support Subsurface Utility Engineering (SUE) projects throughout the Midwest region.
Perform and oversee hands-on field investigations, particularly during the initial development and growth of the regional program.
Lead and perform private utility locating, concrete scanning, and other subsurface investigations.
Provide technical expertise regarding the capabilities and limitations of various geophysical methodologies and advise clients on appropriate investigation strategies.
Support SUE activities and utility investigations, including applicable Quality Level A–D services based on project scope and team capabilities.
Oversee the collection, processing, interpretation, and quality review of geophysical and utility investigation data.
Prepare and review technical reports, maps, figures, field documentation, and client deliverables.
Lead day-to-day field operations, including staff scheduling, resource planning, equipment coordination, project execution, and field support.
Train, mentor, and develop SUE staff, strengthening the technical capabilities of the regional team.
Establish consistent field procedures, technical standards, QA/QC practices, and documentation expectations.
Coordinate with UES engineering, environmental, geotechnical, construction materials, surveying, and other technical teams to identify opportunities for geophysics and SUE services.
Manage assigned projects from initial client contact through scope development, field execution, reporting, invoicing, and closeout.
Develop project scopes, estimates, proposals, pricing, schedules, and budgets.
Monitor project performance to ensure work is completed safely, accurately, on schedule, within scope, and in accordance with client expectations.
Develop and maintain relationships with clients, contractors, municipalities, engineers, and other industry partners.
Actively identify opportunities for additional work with existing and prospective clients.
Participate in presentations, networking, lead generation, proposal development, and other business development activities.
Serve as a technical resource during client discussions and help communicate the value, applications, and limitations of UES SUE capabilities.
Support the continued growth and development of the regional SUE practice, including evaluating equipment, staffing, training, and future service needs.
Travel throughout the Midwest region and nationally as needed to support projects, clients, staff training, and business development.
Ensure work is performed in accordance with UES safety procedures, applicable regulations, industry standards, and project requirements.
Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Geology, Geophysics or similar degree
At least 1-2 years of private utility locating utilizing radio detection, Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), and other geophysical tools.
Experience with utilizing CAD, GIS, and other mapping software
Prior experience in geology field work, geophysics, or civil engineering with knowledge in construction, geotechnical and/or environmental services.
Valid driver’s license with acceptable driving record
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and industry-specific platforms (e.g., project management, data reporting systems).
Strong organizational, communication, and analytical skills
Willingness to travel to job sites and work in diverse environmental conditions
Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage multiple priorities, and interface with clients and regulatory bodies effectively

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of relevant professional experience in engineering consulting, environmental consulting, geotechnical services, infrastructure, construction, field investigation, monitoring, or a related technical environment.
Utility locating or subsurface utility investigations
Concrete scanning
Geophysical investigations or geophysical field methods
Seismic testing, investigations, data collection, processing, or interpretation
Vibration monitoring and/or construction vibration monitoring
Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR)
Electrical resistivity or electrical imaging methods
Electromagnetic methods
Specialized field instrumentation and monitoring systems
Sensor installation, monitoring, and data acquisition
Technical data processing, visualization, or interpretation
Geologic or subsurface characterization
Environmental or geotechnical field investigations
Infrastructure, transportation, construction, or engineering consulting projects
Client-facing consulting experience
Proposal preparation, scope development, or project budgeting
Experience coordinating or mentoring field personnel

Travel Requirements

This position requires occasional travel, approximately 70% of the time, to support business

objectives and client engagements. Travel may be both scheduled and on short notice, depending on

project needs. Destinations typically include job sites, field locations, or regional offices, where work may

be conducted in outdoor or operational environments. Adherence to all company safety protocols and

use of PPE is required during travel and on-site work.

#

LI-ND1

Physical Demands & Work Environment

This position operates in a hybrid work environment, requiring flexibility to work effectively from both a professional office and work site setting.
On-Site Office Requirements:
Work is performed at a desk for extended periods using a computer, phone, and standard office equipment in a climate-controlled office environment.
Regular in-person communication with team members, clients, and stakeholders is required.
Physical demands may include sitting for long durations, occasional standing, walking, bending, and lifting of materials up to 15 pounds.

Field Environment:
Work at outdoor sites including wetlands, forests, grasslands, construction zones, and undeveloped land.
Travel on foot across uneven, rugged, or obstructed terrain, sometimes in areas inaccessible by vehicle.
Exposure to varying weather conditions including heat, cold, humidity, rain, or sun.
Possible presence of insects, animals, or natural and man-made hazards in field environments.

Physical Requirements:
Ability to lift and carry between 35–75 lbs. of equipment or samples over distances up to 75 feet.
Ability to stand, walk, drive, and operate lab and field equipment for extended periods.
Ability to bend, twist, reach, stoop, kneel, climb, and balance as needed during both lab and fieldwork.
Ability to communicate effectively in both verbal and written formats in varied environments, often while wearing PPE.
Ability to use sensory capabilities to see (including close and distant vision, color perception, depth perception, and focus) and smell for observation and safety purposes

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst - MARVEL Strike Force
new_jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Data Analyst
to join our Marvel Strike Force
remotely in the United States or Canada on a remote basis

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Marvel Strike Force
is Scopely's squad-based Hero Collector RPG, housing heroes and villains across the Marvel Universe.

What You Will Do

Use AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to accelerate analytical workflows, including data exploration, SQL/Python development, documentation, QA, summarization, and insight generation, while maintaining strong judgment around data quality, accuracy, privacy, and business context
Partner with product, design, economy, live operations, marketing, and leadership teams to turn data into clear insights that improve player engagement, retention, monetization, and long-term game health
Own recurring business-health reporting for Marvel Strike Force, including KPI reads, trend context, variance explanations, and executive-ready narratives for what changed, why it changed, and what to do next
Analyze player behavior across onboarding, progression, events, offers, combat modes, and other core game systems to identify risks, opportunities, and player-impacting friction
Design and validate analytics tracking for new features, live events, player offers, and experiments so teams can measure performance accurately from launch onwar

What We're Looking For

B.Tech/BS in Computer Science, Statistics, Math, Physics or other quantitative disciplines
2+ years of experience in data analytics, product analytics, business analytics, financial analysis, data science, or a similar quantitative role
2+ years’ experience using SQL/Python, including complex queries from multiple data sources
2+ years’ experience creating reports using Tableau/Looker or a similar reporting system
Curiosity and hands-on interest in using AI tools to improve analytics workflows, with the judgment to validate outputs, protect sensitive data, and distinguish useful acceleration from unsupported conclusions
Familiarity with experimentation, including A/B test design, metric selection, statistical significance, guardrail metrics, and post-test interpretation
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to turn detailed analysis into concise, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical partners
Comfort working quickly in a live-service environment where priorities shift, data is imperfect, and decisions often need both speed and rigor

Bonus Points

Demonstrates openness to using AI-enabled tools to improve analytical workflows, accelerate insight generation, and support high-quality data-driven decision-making
Passion for games and curiosity about what motivates players, especially in RPG, hero collector, strategy, or squad-based combat games
Advanced degrees a plus
2+ years within the mobile gaming domain
Experience analyzing player lifecycle metrics such as onboarding, funnels, retention, engagement, progression, monetization, economy health, offers, events, or churn
Experience with modern analytics workflows such as dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Git, notebook-based analysis, or reusable data models

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

JM Test Systems is hiring a Senior Strategy Analyst to serve as a thought partner to our executive and commercial teams. This role owns the questions that shape where the business goes next — where our growth is coming from, which customers and service lines deserve more investment, what our markets and competitors are telling us, and what we should do differently as a result.

As a Portfolio Management Program Analyst in the US Equities team, you will help drive day-to-day portfolio activities while building deep knowledge of the team's investment engine, including its philosophy, process, research inputs, and the practical mechanics required to manage institutional-scale portfolios. new_jobs.title: Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Project Manager who enjoys bringing people, ideas, and plans together to get meaningful work done.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for guiding projects from the early planning stage through completion. You’ll work closely with different teams, keep everyone aligned, manage timelines and priorities, and make sure the details don’t get lost along the way.

More than anything, we’re looking for someone who is organized, practical, and comfortable working with people. You don’t need to have every answer on day one, but you should know how to ask the right questions, communicate clearly, and keep things moving when challenges come up.

What You’ll Do

Lead projects from planning through delivery, keeping scope, timelines, and priorities on track.
Work closely with internal teams, clients, vendors, and other stakeholders to keep everyone aligned.
Build project plans, establish milestones, and make sure responsibilities are clear.
Monitor progress, identify risks early, and work with the right people to resolve issues.
Keep stakeholders informed through clear, timely, and straightforward communication.
Coordinate meetings, follow-ups, action items, and important project documentation.
Help teams stay focused when priorities change or unexpected challenges come up.
Track project budgets, resources, and timelines where required.
Look for better ways to improve how projects are planned, managed, and delivered.
Step in when something is unclear and help turn it into a practical next step.

What We’re Looking For

Experience managing projects from start to finish.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.
Clear, confident communication and the ability to work well with different personalities and teams.
A practical approach to solving problems rather than simply pointing them out.
The ability to manage several priorities without losing sight of the bigger picture.
Comfort working with changing priorities and deadlines.
Strong attention to detail without getting stuck in the details.
Experience with project management tools and collaboration platforms.
A team-first mindset and a genuine interest in helping others succeed.

What Will Make You Successful

You’re someone people can rely on. When you say you’ll follow up, you do. When a project starts to drift, you notice it and take action. When there’s a difficult conversation to have, you don’t avoid it.

You understand that project management is not just about schedules, spreadsheets, and status updates. It’s about people. It’s about creating clarity, building trust, removing roadblocks, and helping a team do its best work.

Why Join Us

We want people to feel that their work matters and that their contribution is noticed. You’ll have the opportunity to work with talented people, take ownership of meaningful projects, and have a real say in how we improve the way we work.

If you’re the kind of Project Manager who likes turning plans into progress and enjoys seeing a team succeed together, we’d love to hear from you.

The Information Technology Business Analyst and Change Control Support uses analysis and design techniques to solve business problems using information technology and may serve as a change agent who identifies the organizational improvements needed, design systems to implement those changes, and assist with training and motivating others to use the systems.The incumbent supports system testing, issue and action item management, and change management. About Us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The role

As a Technical Program Manager at Wayve, you'll lead complex, cross-functional programs across our engineering org - spanning AI, software, robotics, infrastructure, evaluation, validation, data, and product. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans and keep multi-team delivery predictable in a fast-moving environment.

Working closely with engineering and cross-functional partners, your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver programs, drive efficiency, manage risk, and align execution with business goals. A successful TPM is a force multiplier - helping teams move faster, more effectively, and with purpose.

We hire TPMs across several areas - for example robotics, evaluation & validation, AI platform, and data operations - and we'll explore the best fit with you through the process.

Key Responsibilities

Drive project delivery: Own the project lifecycle and improve delivery outcomes through structured execution and coordination.
Boost efficiency: Identify bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and improve tooling and resource allocation to increase throughput.
Enable cross-team collaboration: Improve alignment across teams through effective communication, shared goals, and faster decisions.
Manage risk proactively: Anticipate issues, develop mitigation plans, and minimise impact on timelines and quality.
Keep stakeholders aligned: Engage regularly with internal stakeholders, manage expectations, and deliver on commitments.
Align with business goals: Ensure programs directly support Wayve's strategic priorities by making smart scope and resource decisions.
Champion continuous improvement: Lead retros, encourage feedback, and implement changes to improve processes, team dynamics, and outcomes.

About you

We're looking for the following skills and experience. (The first three are our must-haves.)

Essential

Bias for action / program delivery: 5+ years leading complex, multi-team software or technology programs in fast-paced or early-stage environments. You get things done.
Technically strong: Comfortable working with engineers and reasoning about modern software, ML, and robotics stacks, even if you don't write code.
Systems thinking: You reason about how the parts of a complex system fit together, and how a change in one area ripples into others.
Stays neutral and adapts under pressure: Effective in high-tension, ambiguous situations; you flex your style to keep people aligned and moving.
Strong project management: Skilled at planning, prioritising, managing risk and dependencies, and adapting as things change.
Clear communicator: You explain complex ideas simply, surface risk early, listen well, and keep teams aligned.
Collaborative leader: You bring people together, influence without authority, and create a positive team culture.
Strategic thinking & problem-solving: You keep the bigger picture in mind, stay calm under pressure, and find creative solutions.
Product-minded: You focus on outcomes and the people your programs serve - prioritising by impact and defining what good looks like, not just tracking activity.
Growth mindset: Open to feedback and always looking to improve.

Desirable

Ideally 8+ years as a Technical Program Manager.
An engineering or computer science degree, or experience working as an engineer; excels in Jira (or similar).
Exposure to autonomous vehicles, robotics, ML, simulation / evaluation, or other safety-critical or compute-heavy domains.

This role is a full-time role based in Sunnyvale, CA (hybrid) and the reasonably estimated salary for this role ranges from $171,600 to $274,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.
